caption:
Kindness to parents: who deserves your best treatment first?

When a man asked who is most deserving of his good treatment, the Prophet ﷺ named the mother three times, then the father, then the nearest relatives.

Sahih Muslim 6501 · Grade: Sahih

Call your mother tonight, or make du'a for her if she has passed on.

#sahihmuslim #kindnesstoparents #birrulwalidayn #mother
alt_text: Abu Huraira reported that a person said:Allah's Messenger, who amongst the people is most deserving of my good treatment? He said: Your mother, again your mother, again your mother, then your father, then your nearest relatives according to the order (of nearness) (Sahih Muslim 6501)
